targets.name: OCT-0.06

targets.name: OCT-0.25
targets.expect: Lockup top-left; a ruled pen with a gate in its left wall, ~1,000 roaches settled from the far wall; three counts above it (about 150, more than 700 greyed; nearly 1,000 bright), each with a star and claimant; caption 0 in the right column, not over the pen.

targets.name: OCT-0.56

targets.name: OCT-0.68

targets.name: OCT-0.83
targets.expect: Only the cell: two roaches inside the barred cell, names under it; '7 days in judicial custody* 14 – 21 Oct' with a full tally (gate of five + two) to its right; caption 3 right (Mumbai beat removed, Vali 2026-11-13).

targets.name: OCT-0.97
targets.expect: The Amnesty quote on its own: centred, no card, nothing behind it (cell faded out); 14 Oct kicker, attribution under it with its star; lockup still top-left.
